title: Open total tensor coefficient comparison data
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small Grothendieck site, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, and $V\in\mathcal C$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site] [def-weil-size-convention]. Use module sheaves, sheaf tensor and unbounded signed direct-sum total cochain tensor [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], the actual localized extension and restriction [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact], scalar extension and balanced scalar comparisons [def-pur-cochain-coefficient-arrows], and the original extension-summand generators [def-sf-localized-strict-tensor-comparison-data]. For $A\in(R\downarrow\mathrm{CAlg}(\mathcal C))$, $Q$ over $R_V$ and $F$ over $R$, define $G=\operatorname{Tot}(j_{R!}Q\otimes_R F)$, $G_V=\operatorname{Tot}(Q\otimes_{R_V}j^*F)$, $X_A=A\otimes_R G$, $I_A=\operatorname{Tot}((A\otimes_Rj_{R!}Q)\otimes_A(A\otimes_RF))$, and $Y_A=j_{A!}\operatorname{Tot}((A_V\otimes_{R_V}Q)\otimes_{A_V}j^*(A\otimes_RF))$. Their homogeneous generators are the images of $([x]_f\otimes y)\otimes a$ and $[(x\otimes a)\otimes(y\otimes b)]_f$. Comparison data consist of ordinary total-tensor isomorphisms $\gamma^B$ for every coefficient sheaf $B$, coefficient-linear isomorphisms $r_{Q,A}:A\otimes_Rj_{R!}Q\cong j_{A!}(A_V\otimes_{R_V}Q)$, and the restriction/scalar-extension isomorphisms. The two balanced comparisons are the existing normalized $\varepsilon$, with the slice comparison followed by the restriction/scalar identification.
